profile.headline: Software Engineer III @ JPMorganChase | ETL Data Pipelines, AWS
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase, I work with a team of developers to design, develop, and deploy scalable and secure applications using MVC, OOP, and Snowflake Cloud technologies. I have contributed to several projects that improved the efficiency, performance, and user experience of the company's systems. For example, I helped implement a new authentication feature that increased the security and reliability of the online banking platform. I also supported the testing and debugging of the applications, ensuring that they met the quality standards and specifications.

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science at Florida International University, where I have learned the fundamental concepts and skills of software development, such as data structures, algorithms, databases, and programming languages. I have also obtained multiple certifications that demonstrate my proficiency and interest in cloud computing and Java programming, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer. Additionally, I have completed a cohort program at Code Differently, where I gained hands-on experience and mentorship in agile software development and Scrum methodologies.

I am passionate about learning new technologies and solving complex problems. I am eager to apply my knowledge and skills to any opportunity that challenges me and enhances my personal and professional growth. I am very excited to gain new experiences and collaborate with other talented and innovative engineers. My goal is to create software solutions that make a positive impact on society and the environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Developed ETL data pipelines using Apache Spark, Apache Hive, and AWS EMR at JPMorganChase.
• Implemented batch extract transform load processes to optimize data processing efficiency.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless data integration and analysis.
